mission.title: String Pulling
mission.description: Lead the Merovingian's agents, disguised as Zion operatives, against the Cypherites.

npc.say: There you are, {player}... so where's this crack team of Zion commandos the boss was talkin' about?

phase.briefing:
Time to put those unruly Zion pests in their place, {player}. I think it's time to call in the Cypherites.
Go meet with Wallaby. She and her people are disguised as Zion operatives... I never do get tired of these charades, you know.

enter.say: Okay, Wallaby and Finsen are in here. Gather them up and get out of there.

talk.say: Uh... I fight for... uh... Niobe!

objective.text: Lead Wallaby out of the area
Lead Finsen out of the area

phase.briefing: Wallaby and Finsen will assist you in an attack on the Cypherites. This really is too pleasant, crushing them and then watching them go after those cave monkeys.

enter.say: I'm reading a lot of enemies in here. Keep an eye on Finsen -- he's not exactly, uh... confidence-inspiring...

done.say: That's the last of them! Now get Wallaby and Finsen out of there.

objective.text: Lead Wallaby and Finsen out of the area

phase.briefing: Time to drop off your merry band of followers. Swing by our local base and drop them off with Akiyama. They certainly served their purpose, eh?

objective.text: Lead Wallaby and Finsen to Akiyama

done.say: There you are, {player}... so where's this crack team of Zion commandos the boss was talkin' about?
These guys still give me the creeps. You can get out of there now.

phase.briefing:
According to our monitoring, it looks like we've started a little brawl between Zion and the Cypherites! Oh, {player}, I do so love a fight... watching it, I mean.
Get over to that location, and see if you can lend a hand to those poor, downtrodden masked freaks.

enter.say: I think you might be too late; looks like the fighting has died down. Better have a look around.

done.say: Hmm... looks like the Cypherites didn't do so well. Be sure and check all of these bodies for anything useful.
A disk, huh? Better get that to a hardline.

objective.text: Upload the disk at a hardline

mission.finish:
Very disappointing. You just can't count on good help from misled fools these days...
I'll have my people take a look at that disk. We'll be in touch, {player}. It's one of the sacrifices my job requires.
